originalLine: - [ ] 1.1 Controlled live QA actor. Execute exactly one native sandbox tool command: node scripts/qa-model-routing-actor.mjs codex <your exact report_path>. The reviewed helper is authorized to wait for the host release, create and commit one fixture marker in raf-develop, and atomically write your final report. Do not edit the helper, tasks, configuration, model or effort; do not run tests, archive or invoke raf. Preserve failure evidence. Keep the native session alive after completion for host observation.
